question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Costing an arm and a leg
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Costing an arm and a leg"** means something that is very expensive or costly. (बहुत महंगा)

 
 
• **Example:** That designer handbag** costs an arm and a leg.**
 
 
 
• **Very costly and luxurious** refers to items or experiences that are extremely expensive and often high-end or opulent. (बहुत महंगा और शानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The five-star hotel offers **very costly and luxuriou**s accommodations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Very entertaining and jovial** (बहुत मनोरंजक और खुशमिजाज): Something that is highly amusing and cheerful.

 
 
• **Example:** The comedy show was very entertaining and jovial.
 
 
 
• **Very attractive and cheap** (बहुत आकर्षक और सस्ता): Something that looks good but is inexpensive.
 
 
• **Example:** The dress was very attractive and cheap, perfect for the party.
 
 
 
• **Very rough and tough** (बहुत कठोर और मजबूत): Something that is very strong and durable.
 
 
• **Example:** The terrain was very rough and tough, challenging for the hikers.
 
 

41:Tdc4,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
